scheme_name: HIMAYAT- Deen Dayal Upadhyaya-Grameen Kaushalya Yojana
other_conditions: Applicant must be a permanent resident of the state of Jammu & Kashmir.
Age limit is 18–35 years, with an upper limit of 45 years for women, PVTGs, PwDs, transgender people, and other special groups.
benefits_summary: Free skill training (3‑12 months) with at least 70% placement assurance and post‑placement support for both urban and rural youth.
